description: List the channels alerts can be sent to: Slack channels, Telegram chats, Discord and Teams channels, email address lists, webhooks. Add a Slack, Discord or Teams channel or a webhook with create_channel; Telegram chats connect from the dashboard (Settings, Integrations), not through the API.

workspaceId.description: Optional. Run this call inside one of your child workspaces (org_..., from list_workspaces) instead of your own. Applies to this call only; the result says which workspace it acted on.

name: list_channels
title: List channels
